PagerBot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate on inference-prod-us-east (route: /v1/generate) — +12% error rate over 3m, spike at 6301112218. Docs: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/6301112222>
Alyssa Chen: ack. I'm oncall, looking now. Any specific model or pool?
Devon Patel: seeing segfaults in model-runner pods, QNAT quant path. Logs show repeated 'segfault 0x0' from libattention.so
Alyssa Chen: pulling logs — running `kubectl -n inference logs model-runner-0f9 --tail=200`
Alyssa Chen: ```
[2026-03-15T14:37:42Z] model-runner[2345]: ERROR: runtime: signal SEGV
[2026-03-15T14:37:42Z] model-runner[2345]: backtrace: ... libattention.so+0x1fa3
[2026-03-15T14:37:42Z] model-runner[2345]: OOM? no, memory ok. repeated on quantized kernels
```
Maria Gomez: customer-impact check: SupportOps says 3 enterprise customers have increased 5xx, and webhooks are timing out (20s+). Standby region healthy.
Devon Patel: I can hotpatch to disable quant_attention via SIGHUP config toggle. Will deploy to 2 pods in canary.
SRE Oncall: Recommend rerouting traffic to model-variant 'gpt-mini-safe' for critical customers while we debug. I can update router policy.
SupportOps: Please attach list of affected customer IDs — paging them now.
Alyssa Chen: Action plan: 1) Canary disable quant path on two pods (in progress) 2) Update routing for enterprise tenants -> gpt-mini-safe 3) Collect core dumps and symbols -> upload to /artifacts/6301112222
Devon Patel: Canary applied: `/deploy canary disable-quant --pod model-runner-0f9` — responding pod restarted and is now serving without segfaults.
PagerBot: Incident channel updated: status=investigating, severity=high
Alyssa Chen: Rolling to remaining nodes (4/6) — throttled to keep latency SLO. Will monitor error rate.
Maria Gomez: Current metrics: 5xx down from +12% -> +3% after canary and reroute. Customer impact: degraded for 3 customers, mitigation in place.
SRE Oncall: I'm taking the handoff at 6301112245 — @Alyssa please summarize state for next oncall.
Alyssa Chen: Handoff summary: quant-attention kernel causing segfaults on inference-prod-us-east. Canary disable worked; routing fallback for enterprise applied. Next: collect cores, trace regressions with latest quant kernels, schedule rollback if stable. Links: incident doc, logs, cores.
SRE Oncall: Thanks — will keep monitoring and coordinate postmortem. If error rate rises >5% re-pager.
SupportOps: Notifying affected customers with mitigation note. :thumbsup:
InfraBot: Auto-snapshot taken for pods model-runner-* at 6301112258
Alyssa Chen: closing live triage, moving to incident review. final error rate at 6301112286 = 2.1%.
